description: Recent Bitcoin transactions touching one address, read from the mempool.space block explorer API (mainnet by default; testnet, signet, and Liquid also selectable). Returns up to 50 transactions with txid, inputs, outputs, values in satoshis, fee, size, and confirmation status. Answers what a BTC address has been sending or receiving lately.

network.description: Which Bitcoin network. Defaults to mainnet — the real Bitcoin network, which is what "Bitcoin" means in an ordinary question. "bitcoin" and "btc" are accepted as aliases for mainnet.

name: get_address_transactions
